experiments.title: 프롬프트 1 기록
experiments.promptTitle: 일본 패션 이커머스 프로모션 배너 — 기반
experiments.actualPrompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: finished commercial square promotional banner for Japanese fashion e-commerce
Primary request: 일본 패션 이커머스를 위한 상업용 프로모션 배너. 눈이 내리는 ice blue 배경 위에 하단 좌측에는 회색 패딩, 진갈색 골덴 긴 바지, 검은색 떡볶이 코트, 짙은 파랑색 니트, 빨간색・초록색 체크 목도리를 사실적인 배경 제거 상품 사진 콜라주로, 바닥에서 펑 튀어 오르는 듯한 역동적인 부채꼴 리듬으로 배치한다. 각 의류는 하나씩만 등장하고 서로 알아볼 수 있게 분리한다.
Layout: 우측 상단에는 네이비색 테두리의 흰색 원형 패널을 만들고 검정, 파랑, 갈색, 분홍, 연노랑 캐릭터 키링 5개를 균일하게 정렬한다. 좌측 상단에는 큰 영문 “MUSINSA”. 그 아래 파란색 원형 안에 “17,000円以上の購入で”. 그 아래 흰색 외곽선이 있는 굵은 파란색 문구 “キーリングプレゼント！”. 상품 사진 옆에는 불투명한 모서리가 둥근 직사각형을 세로로 배치한다. 첫 직사각형에는 “最大93% ＋追加18%OFF”를 넣고 “93%”와 “18%”만 굵게. 두 번째 직사각형에는 “送料無料”. 그 아래 “期間限定 12/15〜12/28”을 넣고 “12/15〜12/28”만 굵게. 최하단 전체 너비의 네이비색 CTA 바에는 흰색 굵은 글자 “<<< MUSINSA GLOBAL AWARDS >>>”. 키링 원형 패널 상단에는 “数量限定”.
Style/medium: 겨울 분위기의 일본 온라인 쇼핑몰 세일 전단과 트렌디한 K-패션 광고를 결합한 완성도 높은 상업 디자인. 사실적인 누끼 상품 사진과 굵고 선명한 일본 광고 타이포그래피. 아이스 블루, 네이비, 코발트 블루, 흰색 중심의 강한 대비.
Composition/framing: square 1:1, dense but clean retail layout, clear hierarchy, safe margins, no cropped copy.
Text (verbatim; render each exactly once): “MUSINSA”; “17,000円以上の購入で”; “キーリングプレゼント！”; “最大93% ＋追加18%OFF”; “送料無料”; “期間限定 12/15〜12/28”; “<<< MUSINSA GLOBAL AWARDS >>>”; “数量限定”.
Constraints: only the eight specified text strings; accurate Japanese characters and numbers; exactly five keyrings in black, blue, brown, pink, and pale yellow; exactly one gray puffer jacket, one dark brown corduroy long pants, one black duffle coat, one dark blue knit, one red-and-green checked scarf; preserve believable relative product scale; all products fully recognizable.
Avoid: any extra letters, words, logos, labels, prices, badges, or watermarks; people, faces, bodies, mannequins, hangers; duplicated garments or keyrings; distorted sleeves, pant legs, coat closures, scarf patterns; illegible or clipped text.
experiments.change: 기반 프롬프트의 밝은 블루그레이 중앙 콜라주를 눈 내리는 아이스 블루 배경과 좌하단에서 튀어 오르는 의류 콜라주로 변경. MUSINSA를 좌상단 대형 헤드라인으로 이동하고, 키링 원형 패널을 우상단에 배치. 할인·무료배송·기간 정보를 우측 세로 카드로 재구성하고 최하단을 네이비 CTA로 변경.
experiments.worked: 의류 5종과 키링 5개가 각각 한 번씩 명확하게 표현됨. 사람·마네킹·행거·워터마크가 없고, 겨울 아이스 블루 배경과 일본 세일 전단형 정보 위계가 잘 구현됨. 주요 일본어 문구도 읽을 수 있는 수준으로 생성됨.
experiments.failed: 지정한 전각 기호가 완전히 보존되지 않음. ‘最大93% ＋追加18%OFF’의 ＋가 일반 + 형태로 보이고, 날짜 범위의 〜도 일반 물결표에 가깝게 렌더링됨. 키링 색상은 맞지만 캐릭터 종류가 서로 통일되지 않음.
experiments.next: 사용자 피드백을 받은 뒤 다음 프롬프트에서 텍스트 기호 정확도와 키링 캐릭터 일관성을 우선 검증.

experiments.title: 보정 실험 1 — 전체 배경
experiments.promptTitle: 일본 패션 이커머스 프로모션 배너 — 기반
experiments.actualPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: Japanese fashion e-commerce square promotional banner, iteration 2
Input image: Image 1 is the edit target and must remain the visual authority.
Primary request: Change only two things in Image 1.
1) Recompose the five character keyrings inside the upper-right white circular panel so that every keyring, including the full metal clasp and character body, is completely contained within the navy circular border. Arrange exactly five keyrings—black, blue, brown, pink, and pale yellow—in a compact balanced 2-over-3 grid with generous inner padding. No part may touch or cross the border or overlap the “数量限定” header.
2) Replace the large decorative snowflakes, starbursts, and intense snow spray in the ice-blue background with gentle, fine, softly falling powder snow: many small subtle flakes, low contrast, calm fluffy snowfall, no large snowflake icons and no blizzard effect. Keep the background clearly wintery.
Preserve exactly: the square composition; all five garments and their positions, colors, scale, shapes, and count; all typography, wording, spelling, hierarchy, colors, panels, CTA, margins, and placements; the MUSINSA headline; blue purchase badge; keyring gift headline; discount, shipping and date cards; bottom navy CTA.
Text invariants: do not add, remove, rewrite, translate, duplicate, or reposition any text. Preserve all visible text exactly as in Image 1.
Constraints: exactly five keyrings fully inside the white circle; gentle fine snowfall only; no people, mannequins, hangers, extra products, extra text, logos, or watermark. Change only the keyring containment and snowfall character; everything else must remain visually identical.
experiments.change: 프롬프트 1 결과에서 키링 5개의 금속 고리와 캐릭터 몸체가 원형 패널 경계 안에 완전히 들어가도록 2행 배열과 내부 여백을 재조정. 큰 장식 눈송이·별빛·강한 눈보라를 작고 낮은 대비의 부드러운 보슬눈으로 변경. 그 외 상품, 카피, 정보 패널과 CTA는 유지하도록 지정.
experiments.worked: 키링 5개가 모두 네이비 원형 경계 안쪽에 충분한 여백을 두고 수납됨. 배경의 눈이 작고 부드러운 보슬눈으로 정리되어 상품과 텍스트의 가독성이 개선됨. 의류 5종, 주요 카피, 정보 카드와 CTA 구성이 유지됨.
experiments.failed: 기존 결과에 있던 전각 기호의 형태 문제는 이미지 편집에서 별도로 수정하지 않았기 때문에 그대로 남아 있음.
experiments.next: 사용자 평가 후 확정하거나, 다음 기록에서 전각 ＋와 〜를 포함한 텍스트 정확도만 별도로 보정.

experiments.title: 보정 실험 2 — 물 표현 사실감
experiments.promptTitle: 일본 패션 이커머스 프로모션 배너 — 기반
experiments.actualPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: Japanese fashion e-commerce square promotional banner, iteration 3
Input image: Image 1 is the edit target and absolute visual authority.
Primary request: Change only the size and fit of the blue headline “キーリングプレゼント！”. Reduce this exact headline slightly, approximately 10–15%, while preserving its current typeface, blue fill, white outline, line breaks, and visual weight. Recenter it within its current middle-top area so it has clear breathing room on both sides: it must not touch or overlap the blue circular “17,000円以上の購入で” badge on the left, the white circular keyring panel or its navy border on the right, the MUSINSA headline above, or any garment below. Keep the complete headline fully readable with safe margins.
Preserve exactly: every character and all existing text; the five keyrings fully contained inside the upper-right circular panel; the gentle fine powder snowfall; all five garments and their positions, colors, scale, and shapes; every information card; the bottom CTA; colors, borders, lighting, background, composition, and square format.
Text invariants: “キーリングプレゼント！” must remain verbatim and appear exactly once. Do not add, remove, rewrite, translate, duplicate, or reposition any other text.
Constraints: change only this headline's size and centering; no new elements, no people, no mannequins, no hangers, no extra products, no extra text, no logos, no watermark.
experiments.change: 프롬프트 2 결과의 ‘キーリングプレゼント！’ 문구만 약 10~15% 축소하고 현재 영역 안에서 다시 중앙 정렬. 왼쪽 구매 배지, 오른쪽 키링 패널, 위쪽 MUSINSA와 아래 의류 사이에 안전 여백을 확보하도록 지정.
experiments.worked: ‘キーリングプレゼント！’가 좌우 요소와 겹치지 않고 완전히 읽히며 충분한 여백을 확보함. 키링 패널 수납, 보슬눈 배경, 의류 5종, 정보 카드와 CTA가 유지됨.
experiments.failed: 기존 이미지의 전각 기호 형태 문제는 이번 수정 범위에 포함하지 않아 그대로 유지됨.
experiments.next: 사용자 평가 후 확정하거나 다음 기록에서 텍스트 기호 정확도를 별도로 보정.

experiments.title: 프롬프트 4 기록
experiments.promptTitle: 일본 패션 이커머스 프로모션 배너 — 기반
experiments.actualPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: Japanese fashion e-commerce square promotional banner, iteration 4
Input image: Image 1 is the edit target and absolute visual authority.
Primary request: Improve readability and contemporary fashion-ad energy by changing only the color hierarchy and surface finish.
Color system:
1) Make the snowy background a paler, slightly desaturated ice blue so products and typography separate clearly. Preserve the gentle fine powder snowfall.
2) Keep MUSINSA, panel borders, supporting copy, shipping text, date text, and the bottom CTA in the existing black/navy/white system.
3) Change only the headline “キーリングプレゼント！” to vivid editorial hot pink while preserving its white outline, current size, line breaks, position, and safe spacing.
4) In the discount card, change only the numerals “93%” and “18%” to the same vivid hot pink. Keep “最大”, “＋追加”, and “OFF” black or navy. Preserve the card's white background and layout.
5) Keep the blue circular “17,000円以上の購入で” badge blue so the hot pink is reserved for the primary gift message and discount numerals.
Surface finish: add an extremely subtle premium printed-paper grain across the flat background and graphic panels, barely visible, without reducing text clarity or making the products look illustrated.
Preserve exactly: all layout, dimensions, wording, Japanese characters, line breaks, type styles, five garments and their placement/colors/scale, five keyrings fully contained in the circular panel, all panels and borders, the bottom CTA, gentle snowfall, square format.
Text invariants: every existing text string must remain verbatim, exactly once. Do not add, remove, rewrite, translate, duplicate, crop, or reposition any text.
Constraints: this is one controlled color-hierarchy experiment. No other changes. No people, mannequins, hangers, extra products, extra text, logos, or watermark.
experiments.change: 색상 위계 실험. 배경을 더 옅고 저채도의 아이스 블루로 낮추고, ‘キーリングプレゼント！’와 할인 숫자 ‘93%’, ‘18%’만 핫핑크로 강조. 나머지 브랜드·보조 정보·패널·CTA는 네이비·화이트 체계를 유지하고, 배경과 그래픽 패널에 미세한 인쇄 질감을 추가.
experiments.worked: 핫핑크가 증정 메시지와 할인 숫자에만 집중되어 첫 시선이 명확해짐. 옅어진 배경으로 검정·네이비 타이포, 흰색 정보 카드와 의류의 분리가 개선됨. 키링 패널과 의류 구성, 보슬눈, 기존 정보 위계가 유지됨.
experiments.failed: 전각 기호 ‘＋’와 날짜 구분 기호 ‘〜’의 기존 렌더링 형태는 이번 색상 실험 범위에서 수정하지 않아 그대로 유지됨.
experiments.next: 사용자 평가 후 이 색상 체계를 확정하거나, 다음 기록에서 텍스트 기호 정확도만 별도로 보정.

experiments.title: 프롬프트 1 기록
experiments.promptTitle: 아쿠아시스 생수 광고 — 기반
experiments.actualPrompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: premium commercial bottled-water advertisement, vertical 4:5

Primary request: Create one finished photorealistic advertisement for a transparent bottled water product.

Scene/backdrop: A deep dark-gray studio gradient background. The floor is covered by a very shallow layer of clean water with physically realistic reflections and gentle ripples.

Subject: Exactly one clear PET water bottle stands perfectly upright at the center, viewed straight-on at bottle eye level. The cap is removed and the bottle mouth is visibly open. The bottle has natural cylindrical commercial-water-bottle proportions, a stable symmetrical base, clean transparent walls, and no deformation.

Water action: A clear stream of water descends from above and enters precisely through the open bottle mouth, visually filling the bottle. A large, elegant, photorealistic vortex of transparent water curves and rotates around the bottle without hiding the label or distorting the bottle silhouette. Inside the bottle, show subtle realistic flowing ripples. On the outer bottle surface, show only a restrained amount of small condensation droplets—fresh and tactile, never excessive.

Label: Apply one translucent pale sky-blue label around the bottle. It must remain transparent enough to reveal the water and bottle behind it.

Text, verbatim, exactly once each and no other text:
1. “Natural mineral water” — small, widely tracked clean sans-serif, positioned above the Korean name on the label.
2. “아쿠아시스” — larger sky-blue clean sans-serif, centered on the label.
Korean spelling lock: 아-쿠-아-시-스. Render exactly “아쿠아시스”, not a variant.

Composition/framing: Vertical 4:5. Centered hero product, full bottle visible, enough safe space above for the incoming water and around the bottle for the vortex. Straight-on camera, eye-level with the bottle. Premium product-photography clarity.

Lighting/mood: Soft sunlight-like illumination descending from directly above, with controlled highlights along the clear bottle edges and water surfaces. Cool, pristine, refreshing mood. Emphasize transparent whites, pale sky blue, and clean blue reflections against the dark gray background.

Materials/textures: Physically accurate transparent PET, refraction, caustics, water surface tension, fine condensation, studio-grade commercial retouching.

Constraints: exactly one bottle; cap absent; open mouth visible; incoming water enters the mouth; label remains front-facing and fully readable; bottle geometry must be straight, symmetrical and undamaged; both approved phrases appear exactly once.

Avoid: any additional label copy, letters, numbers, logo, symbol, cap, hands, people, ice, fruit, mountains, extra bottles or products, excessive droplets, opaque label, warped bottle, misspelled Korean, duplicated text, watermark.
experiments.change: 등록한 기반 프롬프트를 첫 실행용 구조로 정규화. 중앙의 열린 투명 생수병 한 개, 위에서 병 입구로 들어가는 물줄기, 병 주변의 대형 물 회오리, 어두운 회색 배경과 얕은 물 바닥, 두 개의 정확한 라벨 문구를 동시에 검증.
experiments.worked: 4:5 세로 구도에 투명 생수병 한 개가 중앙 정면으로 배치되었고 열린 병 입구로 물줄기가 들어감. 대형 물 회오리와 어두운 회색 배경의 대비가 강하며, ‘Natural mineral water’와 ‘아쿠아시스’가 각각 한 번씩 정확히 표시됨. 손·얼음·추가 제품·워터마크는 관찰되지 않음.
experiments.failed: 병 주변과 표면의 물방울 수가 기반 프롬프트의 ‘절제된 물방울’보다 다소 많아 보이며, 회오리 일부가 투명한 병을 가로질러 병 내부를 관통하는 것처럼 보이는 구간이 있음.
experiments.next: 다음 실험에서는 사용자가 요청하는 변경을 우선 적용하되, 필요하면 물방울 밀도 감소 또는 회오리를 병 뒤·옆으로 분리하는 가설 중 하나만 선택해 검증.

experiments.title: 프롬프트 2 기록
experiments.promptTitle: 아쿠아시스 생수 광고 — 기반
experiments.actualPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: vertical 4:5 premium bottled-water advertisement, iteration 2
Input image: Image 1 is the edit target and visual authority for the bottle, label, typography, water stream, water vortex, lighting, and composition.

Single change only — background correction:
Replace every black, transparent-looking, cutout-like, feathered, irregular, or empty region around the subject with a fully opaque, continuous, full-bleed dark charcoal-gray studio gradient background that covers the entire rectangular 4:5 canvas from edge to edge. There must be no transparency, alpha-like empty area, black cutout silhouette, halo, vignette boundary, torn edge, isolated product cutout, or unfilled corner anywhere.

The background should look like a real seamless commercial photo studio: dark charcoal gray at the outer edges, subtly lighter behind the bottle, with a smooth natural gradient. Extend the shallow wet floor continuously across the full bottom width of the canvas, with restrained realistic reflections and gentle ripples. The bottle, water vortex, and floor must feel photographed together in one complete environment, not pasted onto a background.

Absolute preservation:
Keep exactly one upright open transparent bottle in the same central position, size, proportions, and straight-on eye-level view.
Keep the descending water stream entering the open bottle mouth.
Keep the large water vortex, bottle condensation, label shape and pale sky-blue transparency.
Keep the exact label texts, each exactly once and unchanged:
“Natural mineral water”
“아쿠아시스”
Preserve their spelling, font appearance, size, color, tracking, order, position, and legibility.
Do not add, remove, rewrite, duplicate, resize, or reposition any text.
Keep the cool top-down light, clear PET material, refraction, blue accents, and vertical 4:5 framing.

No new elements. No logo, cap, hand, person, ice, fruit, mountain, extra product, extra text, watermark, transparent background, isolated cutout, or irregular border.
experiments.change: 프롬프트 1 결과의 누끼처럼 보이는 검은 외곽·불규칙한 비네트·빈 모서리만 수정. 4:5 캔버스 전체를 채우는 불투명한 차콜 그레이 스튜디오 그라데이션과 화면 하단 전체 폭의 젖은 바닥으로 연결.
experiments.worked: 불규칙한 검은 외곽과 고립된 누끼 인상이 사라지고, 어두운 회색 배경이 네 모서리와 전체 캔버스를 연속적으로 채움. 젖은 바닥과 병의 접지가 자연스럽게 연결됨. 중앙 병, 물줄기, 회오리와 ‘Natural mineral water’, ‘아쿠아시스’ 문구가 유지됨.
experiments.failed: 병 주변의 물방울 밀도와 회오리가 병 앞을 가로지르는 현상은 이번 단일 배경 수정 범위가 아니므로 그대로 남아 있음.
experiments.next: 사용자가 다음 프롬프트를 제공하면 이 결과를 직전 버전으로 삼아 한 가지 변경 가설을 적용. 배경 전체 채움 규칙은 이후 모든 실험에서 보존 조건으로 유지.

experiments.title: 프롬프트 3 기록
experiments.promptTitle: 아쿠아시스 생수 광고 — 기반
experiments.actualPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: vertical 4:5 premium bottled-water advertisement, iteration 3
Input image: Image 1 is the edit target and the absolute visual authority.

- exactly one transparent 500 ml PET water bottle;
- one closed sky-blue cap;
- original bottle shape, proportions, structural horizontal ribs, clear internal water, central placement and product size;
- natural irregular condensation without repeating droplet patterns;
- refined cool color palette and vertical 4:5 composition;
- the pale sky-blue translucent label;
- these two exact texts, each exactly once, perfectly sharp and unchanged in spelling, font appearance, hierarchy, color, position and direction:
  “Natural mineral water”
  “아쿠아시스”
Korean spelling lock: 아-쿠-아-시-스. Render exactly “아쿠아시스”.

Exclude: any additional copy, logo, symbol, pseudo-text, person, hand, face, mouth, fruit, cup, straw, ice, additional bottle, open cap, rock, sand, plant, foam, giant wave, tall crown splash, water vortex, excessive fog, lens flare, repeated condensation pattern, crushed or warped bottle, distorted label, watermark, illustration, or obvious CGI appearance.

The final image must look like high-end real studio beverage photography: subtle black environment, gently focused lighting, modest low angle with the entire bottle base visible, accurate transparent PET and readable label.
experiments.change: 첨부 이미지의 밝은 베이지 배경과 물보라 바닥을 은은한 국부 조명이 느껴지는 검은 스튜디오 배경·무광 바닥으로 변경. 병 바닥이 완전히 보이는 절제된 로우 앵글과 왼쪽의 차가운 림라이트를 적용.
experiments.worked: 검은 배경이 과도하게 밝아지지 않고 병 주변에만 미세한 명암 집중이 형성됨. 생수병 한 개가 중앙 정면에 유지되고 바닥 전체가 보이는 로우 앵글이 구현됨. 스카이블루 뚜껑과 라벨, ‘Natural mineral water’와 ‘아쿠아시스’ 문구가 각각 한 번씩 선명하게 유지됨. 기존 물보라와 공중 물방울, 반사 바닥은 제거됨.
experiments.failed: 병 전체의 결로 물방울 밀도가 원본보다 높고 하단 리브까지 비교적 균일하게 분포해, 사용자가 요청한 자연스러운 결로 및 반복 패턴 금지 기준에는 추가 검수가 필요함. 강한 파란 림라이트로 일부 PET 윤곽이 실제 촬영보다 연출된 느낌을 줄 수 있음.
experiments.next: 사용자 평가 후 다음 실험에서는 구도와 검은 배경을 유지하고 결로 밀도 또는 파란 림라이트 강도 중 한 요소만 낮춰 검증.

experiments.title: 프롬프트 13 기록
experiments.promptTitle: 아쿠아시스 생수 광고 — 기반
experiments.actualPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: vertical 4:5 premium bottled-water advertisement, official prompt 13 cleanup pass
Input image: Image 1 is the edit target. The directional background light, low base splash, reflection, composition, bottle, and label are approved.

Single correction: remove the dense micro-texture artifact from the PET bottle and wet floor while preserving the approved large-scale water splash and reflection.

Bottle cleanup:
- Reduce attached condensation by approximately 80%.
- Reconstruct all PET areas between the normal large horizontal structural ribs as optically smooth, transparent plastic.
- Keep only a sparse irregular set of physically round droplets: broad dry gaps, a few tiny beads, fewer medium beads, and no dense coverage.
- Every remaining droplet must be a simple natural round or slightly gravity-stretched water bead. No connected outlines and no repeated size or spacing.
- Completely remove every letter-like, pseudo-text, worm, curl, hook, loop, maze, cell, rice-shape, etched, embossed, cracked, tiled, stippled or woven micro-mark from the shoulder, lower body, cap and label.
- Keep droplets away from the two printed texts.

Floor cleanup:
- Keep the low irregular splash sheets and the main isolated airborne droplets, but remove the carpet of tiny repeated beads and shiny micro-dots across the floor.
- Render the wet black floor as broad smooth dark tonal areas with one continuous shallow puddle, a clean soft bottle reflection, and only a few widely separated irregular droplets near the main splash.
- No granular floor texture, pebbling, cellular highlights, repeated circles, tiled reflections, or pseudo-symbols.

Preserve exactly:
- the strong controlled background illumination originating on the RIGHT and traveling toward the LEFT, right side dark charcoal and left side deep black;
- one centered 500 ml bottle, modest low angle, fully visible base, blue closed cap, geometry, ribs, water, label color, product scale and 4:5 crop;
- the low asymmetrical base splash, fading vertical floor reflection, and compact contact relationship;
- the exact texts “Natural mineral water” and “아쿠아시스”, each once, unchanged and sharp.

No new text, logo, symbols, people, hands, ice, extra products, foam, giant wave, tall crown, vortex, fog, lens flare, warped bottle, distorted label, watermark or CGI texture. The final photograph must have clean smooth transparent PET and large quiet surface areas with zero micro-glyph artifacts.
experiments.change: 프롬프트 12의 검은 스튜디오와 로우 앵글을 유지하며 병 바닥에 낮고 비대칭적인 물보라와 흐릿하게 감쇠하는 바닥 반사를 복원. 배경광을 오른쪽의 밝은 차콜에서 왼쪽 딥블랙으로 강하게 흐르게 변경. 1차 결과의 과밀한 결로와 바닥 미세 물방울을 추가 정리해 인공적 반복 텍스처를 억제.
experiments.worked: 오른쪽에서 왼쪽으로 흐르는 배경 조명이 명확하고 병 윤곽과 검은 배경이 분리됨. 병 바닥을 가리지 않는 낮은 물보라와 중앙의 부드러운 반사가 복원됨. 결로가 크게 줄어 PET 사이에 넓고 매끈한 여백이 생겼으며 바닥의 반복적인 미세 물방울도 대부분 제거됨. 두 라벨 문구가 정확히 유지됨.
experiments.failed: 정리 과정에서 원본보다 병 어깨와 하단 리브의 형상이 조금 더 단순하고 매끈하게 재해석됨. 바닥 반사는 자연스럽지만 제품 촬영 기준으로는 파란 윤곽광의 존재감이 여전히 강할 수 있어 사용자 평가가 필요함.
experiments.next: 사용자 평가 후 확정하거나, 다음 실험에서 병 형상은 고정하고 파란 윤곽광 강도만 한 단계 낮춰 검증.

experiments.title: 프롬프트 14 기록
experiments.promptTitle: 아쿠아시스 생수 광고 — 기반
experiments.actualPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: vertical 4:5 premium commercial bottled-water advertisement, official prompt 14
Input image: Image 1 is the edit target and absolute authority for the black studio palette, right-to-left background lighting, label design, exact text, one-bottle identity, and 4:5 format.

Primary request: Make the water bottle substantially more photorealistic, lower the camera viewpoint slightly, and make the floor water impact more dynamic while remaining physically believable.

Bottle realism:
- Reconstruct the bottle as a real mass-produced transparent 500 ml PET bottle photographed with a high-end macro product lens, not a 3D render.
- Preserve the familiar cylindrical bottle proportions, shoulder transition, closed sky-blue cap, neck ring and major horizontal structural ribs, but add subtle real-world manufacturing irregularities: minute asymmetry in rib tension, gentle PET wall waviness, realistic thickness variation at the base, physically correct refraction through clear water, and slight optical compression at curved edges.
- The bottle must remain straight, intact, full and stable. Do not make it perfectly computer-symmetrical, glossy chrome-like, smoky, black-filled, crushed, or inflated.
- Use restrained natural condensation: sparse irregular round droplets, broad dry areas, only a few larger beads and one or two short gravity trails. No dense droplet carpet or repeating pattern.
- Retain smooth clear areas between droplets and ribs; no micro-glyph, etched, maze, worm, letter-like or cellular artifact.

Lower camera and composition:
- Lower the camera by one moderate step so it sits close to the wet floor, looking upward more clearly than Image 1.
- Let the bottle rise more dramatically against the background, with mild physically realistic perspective: the base appears only slightly more prominent and the shoulder/cap recede subtly.
- Keep the complete bottle base visible, never crop or hide it. Preserve a centered frontal label and avoid severe convergence, fisheye distortion, oversized bottom, tiny cap, tilted bottle or warped label.
- Shift the bottle slightly lower in the 4:5 frame while retaining useful black negative space above the cap.

More dynamic floor water:
- Increase the energy of the splash around the base by roughly 40–50% compared with Image 1.
- Create an irregular asymmetric impact: one higher curling sheet on the left, two medium outward arcs on the right, a low forward sheet across the foreground, and a restrained number of separated droplets following different ballistic paths.
- The splash must visibly originate at the bottle-floor contact and wrap partially around the base without obscuring its outline or label.
- Keep the maximum splash height below roughly 15% of bottle height. No giant crown, wave wall, vortex, foam or symmetrical decorative ring.
- Strengthen the wet-floor reflection and rippled highlights directly below the bottle, but keep the reflection soft, broken by water movement, and fading toward the bottom edge—not a mirror duplicate.

Lighting:
- Preserve the strong controlled background illumination that originates off-frame on the RIGHT and travels toward the LEFT: right background dark charcoal-blue, left background deep black.
- Use realistic right-side rim light and restrained cool edge highlights with soft neutral frontal fill. Do not create a glowing outline or overexpose the label.
- Keep the water splash and floor highlights brighter than the matte black floor to produce strong contrast.

Text preservation, exact and once each:
“Natural mineral water”
“아쿠아시스”
Preserve spelling, font appearance, hierarchy, blue colors, position and orientation. Keep the label front-facing, flat-looking and readable.

Exclude: extra text, pseudo-text, logo, symbols, people, hands, ice, fruit, additional bottles, open cap, sand, rocks, plants, foam, giant wave, tall crown splash, water vortex, fog, lens flare, repeating droplets, artificial micro-texture, crushed bottle, warped label, watermark, illustration or obvious CGI.

Final result: convincing real beverage campaign photography from a low floor-level camera, tactile clear PET and water, a more energetic but physically plausible base splash, strong right-to-left background-light contrast, and clean artifact-free surfaces.
experiments.change: 프롬프트 13의 검은 스튜디오와 오른쪽→왼쪽 배경광을 유지하면서 카메라를 젖은 바닥 가까이 한 단계 더 낮춤. 병에 실제 양산 PET의 미세 비대칭·벽 두께·굴절을 지시하고, 바닥 물보라의 에너지를 약 40~50% 높여 좌우 높이와 진행 방향이 다른 비대칭 물막·호·전경 물줄기를 구성.
experiments.worked: 더 낮은 시점에서 병이 배경 위로 솟는 대비가 강해졌고 병 바닥은 완전히 보임. 좌측의 높은 물막, 우측의 여러 호와 전경 물줄기가 서로 다른 방향으로 뻗어 물보라가 이전보다 역동적임. 검은 바닥의 반사가 물 움직임에 의해 끊기며 자연스럽게 감쇠하고, 라벨 두 문구와 오른쪽 배경광이 유지됨.
experiments.failed: 병의 투명 PET와 물은 개선됐지만 강한 청색 윤곽광과 매끈한 리브 때문에 일부 구간은 여전히 고급 CGI 렌더처럼 느껴질 수 있음. 물보라의 좌측 물막은 실제 촬영 기준으로 다소 조형적이며 사용자 평가가 필요함.
experiments.next: 사용자 평가 후 확정하거나 다음 실험에서 조명과 구도를 고정하고 PET의 청색 윤곽광 강도만 낮춰 현실감을 비교.

experiments.title: 프롬프트 3 기록

Vertical 4:5, polished commercial Korean cosmetics advertising, simple and spacious, pale ivory and warm beige palette, soft natural beauty retouching, realistic product photography, subtle depth, no collage cutout edges. experiments.change: 여성 레퍼런스를 인물·포즈의 기준으로 유지하고 상품 레퍼런스에서 용기 구조와 색상을 가져와 우하단에 3개 제품군으로 합성. 우측에서 중앙으로 투명해지는 연베이지 그라데이션, 우상단 로고 여백, 하단의 ‘24기간 밀착력 개선’ 헤드라인을 추가.
experiments.worked: 여성 한 명의 얼굴·포즈·손과 손에 든 콤팩트가 자연스럽게 유지됨. 우하단에 두 개의 닫힌 포트와 한 개의 전면 콤팩트가 크기 차와 간격을 두고 배치됨. 베이지 그라데이션이 얼굴을 가리지 않고 우측 공간을 정리하며, 우상단에 넓은 로고 여백이 남음. 지정 문구가 한 번만 선명하게 표시됨.

experiments.next: 사용자 평가 후 제품 표면의 기존 인쇄 유지 여부 또는 하단 헤드라인 크기 중 한 요소만 조정.

experiments.worked: 하단 문구가 굵은 흰색 글자와 얇은 분홍색 외곽선으로 한눈에 들어오며 ‘24시간 밀착력 개선’이 정확히 한 번 표시됨. 제품군이 우측 중상단에서 전면 원형 제품과 3단 포트로 레퍼런스 구조를 따르고, 여성 얼굴·손·의상과 겹치지 않음. 손에 든 제품과 추가 제품 모두 표면 글자가 제거되어 지정 문구 외 추가 글자·로고가 보이지 않음.
experiments.failed: 제품군이 우측 공간에 안정적으로 배치됐지만 레퍼런스의 비스듬한 적층보다 정돈된 수직 스택에 가까움. 하단 헤드라인은 가독성이 높지만 화면 점유율이 커서 하단 의상의 일부를 덮는 인상이 있음.
experiments.next: 사용자 평가 후 확정하거나, 다음 실험에서 제품 스택의 비스듬한 각도 또는 헤드라인 크기 중 한 요소만 조정.

experiments.title: 프롬프트 5 기록
experiments.promptTitle: 한국 화장품 프라이머 프로모션 배너 — 기반
experiments.actualPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: vertical 4:5 finished commercial Korean cosmetics promotional banner, prompt 5 record

Input images:
- Image 1 is the edit target and absolute authority for the female model, identity, face, pose, hair, hand, held compact, outfit, headline, beige gradient, logo-safe area, lighting and 4:5 composition.
- Image 2 is the product geometry and dimensional still-life reference for the ivory-white and transparent peach-beige cosmetic pots.

Single controlled change: Enlarge and dimensionalize ONLY the added product display on the right.

Product display requirements:
- Keep the product group in the right middle-to-upper zone, below the empty top-right logo-safe margin and above the bottom headline.
- Increase the overall product-group scale by approximately 45–55% compared with Image 1, making it a strong secondary focal point.
- Preserve exactly four added product units: three low round closed pots and one upright front-facing round compact/lid.
- Arrange them as a premium three-dimensional product sculpture inspired by Image 2: one lower pot slightly forward, one middle pot shifted subtly backward-right, one upper pot offset backward-left, and the upright round compact/lid resting securely against the upper pot at a slight three-quarter angle.
- Create convincing spatial depth through perspective, overlap, varied elevation, realistic contact points, soft cast shadows and subtle ambient occlusion. The pots must feel physically present rather than flat icons or pasted cutouts.
- Preserve accurate real product geometry and relative scale: ivory-white rims/lids, transparent peach-beige bodies, circular perspective, consistent wall thickness and realistic translucent material.
- Keep comfortable breathing room around the full group. The product group must NOT overlap or visually interfere with the woman's face, eyes, hairline, ponytail, ear, shoulder, arm, hand or held compact. Maintain a clear negative-space gap between the woman's silhouette and the product display.
- Do not let the enlarged products touch the headline or extend outside the canvas.

Absolute preservation:
- Keep the woman pixel-consistent in appearance: exactly one woman, same identity, expression, pose, skin, makeup, hair, earrings, fingers, sheer beige outfit and body proportions.
- Keep the compact held by her hand unchanged and unprinted.
- Preserve the pale beige right-edge gradient and empty upper-right logo space.
- Preserve the bottom headline exactly once, with identical spelling, bold weight, white fill, thin soft-pink outline, tracking and placement:
“24시간 밀착력 개선”
- The specified Korean headline is the ONLY readable text in the image.

No readable product branding or printing. No “THE SAEM”, “The saem”, logo, pseudo-text, letters, symbols, badges or watermark. No additional person, duplicate body part, mannequin, hanger, distorted clothing, extra product beyond four added units plus the held compact, warped jars, floating products without contact, oversized group blocking the model, illustration or obvious CGI plastic.
experiments.change: 우측 중상단의 추가 제품 4개만 약 45~55% 확대하고, 전후 위치·높이·겹침·접촉 그림자·앰비언트 오클루전을 달리해 3차원 제품 조형물처럼 재배치. 인물 실루엣과 헤드라인 사이의 간격은 유지.
experiments.worked: 우측 제품군이 커져 강한 보조 초점이 되며, 전면 하단 포트와 뒤쪽 2단 스택·상단 원형 제품 사이에 깊이와 높이 차가 생김. 제품의 투명한 베이지 몸체와 아이보리 테두리, 접촉 그림자가 자연스럽고 인물 얼굴·눈·손·어깨 및 하단 문구를 가리지 않음. 지정 문구만 한 번 유지됨.
experiments.failed: 확대된 제품군의 왼쪽 가장자리와 여성의 머리카락 사이 여백이 비교적 좁아 시각적으로 약간 가까워 보임. 제품 조형은 입체적이지만 레퍼런스의 자유로운 비스듬한 적층보다 안정적인 제품 촬영 배치에 가까움.
experiments.next: 사용자 평가 후 확정하거나, 다음 실험에서 제품군 전체를 우측으로 소폭 이동하거나 스택 각도만 비대칭적으로 조정.

experiments.title: 프롬프트 1 기록
experiments.promptTitle: 더샘 여름 밀착 커버 프로모션 — 기반
experiments.actualPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: finished square 1:1 Korean beauty social-commerce summer promotion, prompt 1
Input image: Image 1 is the edit target and absolute product reference. Preserve the exact four photographed THE SAEM products: the three-color correcting compact, beige round compact, open pale-blue powder compact, and beige concealer with glossy black cap. Preserve their packaging geometry, colors, materials, branding already printed on the physical products, and realistic relative scale.

Primary request: Redesign the original conventional sale flyer into a trendy, cool summer K-beauty editorial collage with a pale light-green background.

Scene/background:
Use a luminous pale mint-lime to milky-white gradient background, airy and fresh rather than saturated green. Add extremely subtle watery caustic light and translucent acrylic shadows, like summer sunlight passing through cool glass. Keep generous clean negative space. No literal pool, beach, tropical leaves, fruit, or ice.

Product composition:
Arrange the four original products as an asymmetric editorial collage rather than a rigid grid. Make the open pale-blue compact the largest hero near center-lower. Place the color-correcting palette to the left with a slight counterclockwise tilt, the beige round compact smaller at upper-right, and the concealer vertically at the far right with a slight outward tilt. Maintain intentional breathing room and minimal overlap. Replace the thick white sticker outlines with very thin milky-white 2–3 px cutout edges and soft floating shadows. Products must remain crisp, photorealistic, undistorted, and naturally lit from upper-left.

Typography and hierarchy:
At upper-left place small black “THE saem”. Below it, set a modern bold deep-green Korean sans-serif headline on two clean left-aligned lines:
“여름에도
커버력은 그대로”
Below the headline, add smaller black text:
“더샘 베이스 메이크업 최대 28%”
Do not curve, arch, stretch, or apply perspective distortion to the headline.

Offer badge:
Place one small silver-chrome circular sticker in available negative space near the products. Inside, render:
“UP TO
28%”
Make 28 the largest element, using deep green or cobalt blue. Keep all text fully contained within the circle.

Decorative accents:
Add only 3–5 tiny accents total: a small mint star, two restrained silver sparkles, and one small lime-yellow geometric point. Keep them editorial and sparse.

Footer:
Remove the original thick full-width blue footer bar. At lower-left add small deep-green text:
“6일 특가 · 선착순 증정”
At lower-right place a compact deep-green pill-shaped CTA with milky-white text:
“에이블리 단독 혜택 →”
Keep generous safe margins.

Exact advertising copy, each exactly once and no other added copy:
“THE saem”
“여름에도 커버력은 그대로”
“더샘 베이스 메이크업 최대 28%”
“UP TO 28%”
“6일 특가 · 선착순 증정”
“에이블리 단독 혜택 →”
Physical product branding visible on the reference packages may remain, but do not invent, enlarge, or duplicate brand marks as separate graphics.

Style and lighting:
Fresh summer K-beauty editorial advertising, pale mint-lime, milky white, deep green, small silver and lime accents. Bright diffused summer daylight from upper-left, subtle glass caustics, accurate clear plastic, powder, beige cosmetic liquid, and glossy black metal reflections. Mobile-first clean hierarchy and polished Korean social-commerce art direction.

Avoid: extra text, misspelled Korean, duplicate copy, cropped copy, extra prices or discount numbers, extra cosmetic products, changed package structures, warped circular compacts, deformed concealer, thick white sticker outlines, oversized footer, busy decoration, people, hands, faces, model, flowers, fruit, ice, tropical leaves, water splash, logos added beyond the allowed text and existing physical package print, pseudo-text, watermark, illustration, cartoon, or obvious CGI.
experiments.change: 원본 더샘 상품 4종과 패키지 정체성은 유지하고, 블루그레이 전단형 레이아웃을 연한 민트 라임·밀키 화이트 배경의 여름 에디토리얼 콜라주로 변경. 아치형 제목과 두꺼운 하단 띠를 좌측 정렬 제목·소형 캡슐 CTA로 단순화하고 물결빛·실버 포인트를 추가.
experiments.worked: 연한 연두색 배경과 유리 코스틱 그림자가 시원한 여름 분위기를 형성함. 제품 4종의 형태와 색상이 선명하게 유지되고, 열린 블루 팩트를 중심으로 비대칭적인 제품 위계가 만들어짐. 주요 한글 문구와 할인율, CTA가 정확하고 읽기 쉽게 표시됨.
experiments.failed: 사용자 최종 평가가 필요함. 제품 표면의 기존 THE SAEM 인쇄가 여러 번 보이므로 이를 광고 카피의 중복으로 해석할 경우 후속 편집에서 물리적 패키지 인쇄 유지 범위를 조정해야 함. 중앙 제품과 제목의 크기가 모두 커서 모바일 축소 시 다소 밀도 있게 느껴질 수 있음.
experiments.next: 사용자 평가 후 확정하거나, 다음 실험에서 제품 크기 또는 제목 크기 중 하나만 약 10% 축소해 여백을 추가 검증.

experiments.title: 프롬프트 2 기록
experiments.promptTitle: 더샘 여름 밀착 커버 프로모션 — 기반
experiments.actualPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: finished square 1:1 Korean beauty social-commerce summer promotion, prompt 2
Input image: Image 1 is the edit target and absolute authority for the products, background, typography, exact copy, palette, lighting style, decorative accents, badge, and CTA.

Single controlled change: rearrange ONLY the four cosmetic products into one natural, cohesive commercial product group. The current products feel scattered and unrelated. Create a believable triangular still-life cluster in the lower-middle/right area with consistent perspective, scale, contact, and lighting.

Required product arrangement:
- Keep exactly the same four products and no others.
- Make the open pale-blue powder compact the front-center hero. Place it upright and open, slightly lower than the other products, fully visible, with its lid tilted back naturally.
- Position the three-color correcting compact behind and to the left of the blue compact, approximately 15% smaller due to depth, tilted only 8–12 degrees counterclockwise. Allow a small, physically plausible overlap behind the blue compact's left edge, without hiding the three colored sections.
- Position the beige round compact behind and to the right, approximately the same apparent diameter as the color corrector. Let its lower-left edge sit slightly behind the blue compact's upper-right lid area, while preserving the complete circular silhouette and printed physical brand mark.
- Place the concealer along the right side of the cluster, leaning inward about 10–14 degrees so it visually points toward the center. Its lower end should touch the same surface plane as the compacts rather than float. Keep its glossy black cap and full container visible.
- Build a compact triangular silhouette: beige compact at upper-right, color corrector at upper-left, open blue compact at lower-center, concealer forming the right diagonal edge.
- Keep deliberate but narrow breathing gaps of approximately 12–24 px between major silhouettes, with only two restrained overlaps to show depth.
- Give all four products one shared grounding treatment: consistent upper-left lighting, soft contact shadows falling lower-right, subtle reflected mint light, and one shared pale translucent acrylic shadow beneath the cluster. No separate floating shadows.
- Keep the product group entirely below the subtitle and away from the offer badge, footer copy, and CTA. Do not cover any text.

Absolute preservation:
- Preserve each product's exact packaging geometry, color, material, existing physical THE SAEM print, and recognizable identity.
- Preserve the pale mint-lime and milky-white summer background, watery caustic light, silver and lime decorative accents, headline, subtitle, silver discount badge, footer copy, CTA, typography, colors, exact spelling, positions, and square 1:1 crop.
- Preserve these exact advertising texts, each once: “THE saem”, “여름에도 커버력은 그대로”, “더샘 베이스 메이크업 최대 28%”, “UP TO 28%”, “6일 특가 · 선착순 증정”, “에이블리 단독 혜택 →”.

Do not alter any non-product-layout element. Do not add or remove products, text, logos, badges, decorations, people, hands, models, flowers, fruit, ice, leaves, or water splash. Avoid warped circular cases, merged products, duplicated lids, impossible overlaps, inconsistent perspective, floating products, oversized concealer, thick white cutout borders, cropped packaging, illegible copy, pseudo-text, watermark, illustration, cartoon, or obvious CGI.
experiments.change: 프롬프트 1의 배경·타이포·카피·장식은 유지하고 제품 4종의 배치만 변경. 열린 블루 팩트를 전경 중심에 두고 컬러 코렉터와 베이지 팩트를 뒤쪽 좌우에, 컨실러를 우측 대각선에 배치한 삼각형 제품군으로 통합. 하나의 투명 아크릴 받침과 공통 그림자를 적용.
experiments.worked: 제품 4종이 하나의 삼각형 실루엣으로 자연스럽게 모여 시선이 중앙 블루 팩트로 집중됨. 앞뒤 겹침과 크기 차가 깊이를 만들고, 컨실러의 대각선이 제품군의 오른쪽 경계를 정리함. 공통 아크릴 받침과 동일한 그림자 방향 덕분에 흩어져 떠 있던 느낌이 줄어듦. 모든 광고 문구와 여름 배경이 유지됨.
experiments.failed: 사용자 최종 평가가 필요함. 제품군이 커지면서 중앙 하단의 화면 점유율이 높아졌고, 컬러 코렉터 표면의 물리적 브랜드 인쇄가 다른 제품보다 강하게 보임.
experiments.next: 사용자 평가 후 확정하거나, 다음 실험에서 제품군 전체 크기 또는 컬러 코렉터 브랜드 인쇄 대비 중 한 요소만 조정.

experiments.title: 프롬프트 6 기록
experiments.promptTitle: 한국 화장품 프라이머 프로모션 배너 — 기반
experiments.actualPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: vertical 4:5 finished commercial Korean cosmetics promotional banner, prompt 6 record

Input images:
- Image 1 is the edit target and absolute authority for the woman, identity, face, pose, hair, hand, held compact, outfit, enlarged right-side 3D product display, beige gradient, logo-safe area, lighting and overall composition.
- Image 2 is the product reference and authority for the authentic physical “THE SAEM” wordmark placement and appearance on the round front-facing product surfaces.

Primary edit 1 — replace the bottom headline:
Completely remove the existing phrase “24시간 밀착력 개선”. It must not remain anywhere.
Replace it with exactly these two lines and line break:
Line 1: “실리콘 ZERO로 완성하는”
Line 2: “막힘 없는 베이스”

Typography requirements:
- Use a bold, clean Korean sans-serif with high commercial-banner readability.
- Center-align both lines in the lower section, with balanced line spacing and generous left/right safe margins.
- Keep all Korean text and the word “로” in warm white.
- Highlight ONLY the Latin word “ZERO” in a distinct pink-beige color, approximately muted dusty peach #D99A8C, while preserving identical baseline and weight.
- The emphasis must come from color, not a badge, box, underline, glow, oversized scale or added symbol.
- Keep the two-line block clear of the woman's face, hand and the right-side product display. It may overlap only the visually quiet lower garment/background area.
- Exact text lock: 실-리-콘 / Z-E-R-O-로 / 완-성-하-는 / 막-힘 / 없-는 / 베-이-스.
- Render the complete phrase exactly once. No missing, duplicated or substituted characters.

Primary edit 2 — allow the authentic product logo:
- Restore the authentic physical “THE SAEM” wordmark from Image 2 on the upright round front-facing product in the enlarged right-side display.
- Also restore the same subtle authentic wordmark on the compact held by the woman, matching the product reference's small white sans-serif printing.
- Each allowed physical wordmark may appear once on its corresponding front-facing product surface only.
- Do not place the logo as a separate graphic, in the reserved upper-right logo-safe area, on the background, on the closed jar sides or near the headline.
- Do not add any other brand copy, product names, shade labels, symbols, badges, pseudo-text or watermark.

Absolute preservation:
- Preserve exactly one woman and her face, expression, gaze, hair, earrings, pose, anatomy, fingers, beige sheer outfit, body proportions and beauty photography.
- Preserve the held compact's size, angle and position.
- Preserve exactly four added products on the right, their enlarged 3D arrangement, perspective, translucent peach-beige bodies, ivory-white rims, contact shadows and clear gap from the woman's silhouette.
- Preserve the right-side pale beige gradient, clean upper-right negative space and vertical 4:5 crop.

Avoid: additional person, changed face, malformed fingers, duplicate hands, mannequin, hanger, warped clothing, product duplication, extra product, distorted jars, products overlapping the model or text, extra advertising copy, invented logo, watermark, illustration or obvious CGI.
experiments.change: 하단의 ‘24시간 밀착력 개선’을 두 줄 문구 ‘실리콘 ZERO로 완성하는’ / ‘막힘 없는 베이스’로 교체하고 ZERO만 핑크베이지로 강조. 우측 전면 제품과 여성 손에 든 콤팩트에 레퍼런스 기반의 실제 제품 로고 인쇄를 허용.
experiments.worked: 하단 문구가 정확히 두 줄로 구성되고 ZERO만 핑크베이지 색상과 굵기로 선명하게 강조됨. 인물·제품군·베이지 그라데이션의 위치와 크기가 유지되며 새 문구가 얼굴·손·제품과 충돌하지 않음. 제품 전면과 손에 든 콤팩트에 흰색 물리적 로고 인쇄가 추가됨.
experiments.failed: 우측 전면 제품의 로고가 레퍼런스의 ‘THE saem’과 대소문자 형태가 완전히 일치하지 않고 ‘THE saEM’에 가깝게 보임. 손에 든 제품의 로고도 작아 확대 검수가 필요함. 광고 본문 문구는 정확하지만 허용된 제품 로고의 철자 정확도는 추가 보정 대상.
experiments.next: 사용자 평가 후 확정하거나, 다음 실험에서 다른 요소를 고정하고 두 제품 표면의 로고 철자와 대소문자만 ‘THE saem’으로 보정.

experiments.title: 프롬프트 7 기록
experiments.promptTitle: 한국 화장품 프라이머 프로모션 배너 — 기반
experiments.actualPrompt:
Use case: compositing
Asset type: vertical 4:5 finished commercial Korean cosmetics promotional banner, prompt 7 record

Input images and authority:
- Image 1 is the edit target and absolute authority for the single woman, identity, face, pose, hair, hand, held compact, outfit, beige gradient, lighting, two-line headline, typography, color emphasis, logo-safe area and 4:5 composition.
- Image 2 is the absolute authority for the replacement product visual: one open round peach-beige concealer/primer pot viewed from above, one overlapping circular mirror-like ivory lid with the white physical wordmark “THE SAEM”, translucent peach-beige container rim, and broad diagonal glossy beige product swatches running from upper-right to lower-left. Preserve its geometry, material, relative scale, angle, color, high-key lighting and clean sharp photographic quality.

Single controlled edit:
- Completely remove the existing four-product stacked display from the right-center of Image 1, including every jar, upright compact, shadow and residual edge.
- In exactly that right-center area, insert a cleanly isolated and compositionally adapted version of the product scene from Image 2.
- Show exactly one open round product pot and exactly one overlapping mirror/lid, plus the diagonal cosmetic texture swatches from Image 2. Do not include the former stacked jars.
- Scale the replacement visual large enough to act as a strong secondary focal point, but keep it fully to the right of the woman's silhouette. Maintain a clear negative-space gap from her face, ponytail, ear, shoulder, arm, hand and held compact.
- Keep the replacement below the empty top-right logo-safe margin and above the lower two-line headline. It must not touch or obscure the text.
- Let the glossy beige swatches extend diagonally behind and around the replacement pot within the right-side gradient area, cropped cleanly before reaching the woman's body or headline.
- Match the target banner's warm beige light, contrast and depth. Use high-resolution commercial product photography with crisp circular edges, clean translucent material, accurate reflections and smooth product texture. No blur, pixelation, compression artifacts, jagged cutout edge, halo or mismatched white rectangle.
- Use soft local contact shading so the product visual belongs to the banner, while preserving the light minimal beauty-ad aesthetic.

Text preservation:
Keep the bottom copy exactly as two lines and exactly once:

Allowed product logo:

experiments.change: 우측 중앙의 기존 4개 제품 스택을 완전히 제거하고 새 레퍼런스의 열린 원형 포트 1개, 겹쳐진 반사형 원형 뚜껑 1개, 우상단에서 좌하단으로 흐르는 광택 베이지 제형 스트로크 구성으로 교체. 고해상도 제품 윤곽과 투명 재질을 강조.

experiments.next: 사용자 평가 후 확정하거나, 다음 실험에서 다른 요소를 고정하고 제품 로고 대소문자 또는 제형 스트로크의 프레임 내 종료 위치 중 하나만 보정.

experiments.next: 사용자 평가 후 확정하거나, 다음 실험에서 우측 상단 보조 문구의 불투명도 또는 제품 로고 철자 중 한 요소만 조정.

“더샘 트리플 팟 컨실러
7일 특가”

Create an original floating cosmetic mobile in a clean pastel studio-sky space. Five THE SAEM triple-pot concealers orbit around a large translucent circular acrylic ring, like planets in a refined kinetic sculpture. This is not a vending machine, claw machine, mailbox, chute, tray, capsule machine, arcade prop or product dispenser.

“올영
세일”

“더샘 트리플 팟 컨실러
7일 특가”

Exact advertising copy, each once and no other added copy:
“THE SAEM”
“메이크업 아티스트 치트키”
“올영세일”
“더샘 트리플 팟 컨실러”
“7일 특가”
“SALE 15%”
“8.30–9.5”

Style:
Contemporary Korean beauty editorial with Y2K-futurist restraint, translucent acrylic, chrome orbital lines, pastel aqua-blush gradient, crisp product photography, airy negative space, elegant kinetic motion. Premium and graphic, not childish.

No prize machine, claw machine, mailbox, chute, serving tray, arcade prop, heart-shaped machine detail, clouds, cotton-candy border, realistic sky, centered white bubble headline, large blue circular badge, BBIA text, BBIA products, female model, people, hands, extra products, palettes, pencils, lip products, bottles, extra text, misspelled Korean, duplicate copy, malformed round cases, merged partitions, watermark, illustration, cartoon or cheap CGI.
experiments.change: 프롬프트 3이 BBIA 레퍼런스와 지나치게 유사하다는 사용자 피드백을 반영해 집게 기계·트레이·구름·중앙 흰색 버블 타이포·파란 원형 배지를 모두 폐기. 파스텔 조명만 남기고 투명 아크릴 링과 크롬 궤도를 도는 트리플 팟 5개의 플로팅 코스메틱 모빌로 전면 재구성.
experiments.worked: 집게 기계와 구름이 완전히 사라져 이전 레퍼런스와 구도적 유사성이 크게 줄어듦. 아쿠아-블러시 그라데이션, 투명 링, 크롬 궤도와 비대칭 세로 타이포가 Y2K-퓨처리스트 에디토리얼을 형성함. 제품 5개의 크기 차와 궤도 배치가 자연스러운 깊이와 운동감을 만들고, 할인율은 크롬 타원 배지로 독립적으로 표현됨.
experiments.failed: 사용자 최종 평가가 필요함. 메인 ‘올영세일’ 타이포가 시각적으로 줄 단위로 강하게 분절되어 한 단어보다 네 개의 큰 음절 블록처럼 읽힐 수 있음. 전경 제품의 물리적 THE SAEM 인쇄 대소문자가 상단 광고 로고와 다름.
experiments.next: 사용자 평가 후 확정하거나, 다음 실험에서 메인 타이포 결합감 또는 제품 표면 브랜드 인쇄 중 한 요소만 조정.

experiments.title: 프롬프트 10 기록
experiments.promptTitle: 한국 화장품 프라이머 프로모션 배너 — 기반
experiments.actualPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: finished vertical 4:5 Korean cosmetics advertising poster
Input image: the attached image is the sole edit target and visual authority.

Primary request: perform a professional high-resolution cleanup pass across the complete image without redesigning or repositioning anything.

Quality cleanup:
- Remove blotchy, patchy, marbled, cloudy, waxy, dirty, banded, posterized, compressed, noisy, over-sharpened, embossed-looking, or repeating AI micro-texture artifacts.
- Make the ivory-to-peach background gradient exceptionally smooth and continuous, with clean low-frequency tonal transitions and no color bands, stains, grain clusters, maze-like patterns, or repeated texture.
- Refine the portrait photograph with natural premium beauty-retouch quality: clean tonal transitions and even color while preserving believable fine photographic detail. Avoid plastic blur, waxy surfaces, excessive airbrushing, harsh sharpening, or changed facial features.
- Make hair strands and silhouette edges clean and crisp with no halo, jagged edge, ghosting, smeared strands, or artificial etched patterns.
- Keep the light beige garment visually smooth and refined while retaining subtle realistic fabric transparency and construction. Remove repeating embossed or worm-like micro-pattern artifacts.
- Refine the held compact, the large right-side open product, mirror/lid, translucent rims, and diagonal product swatches: crisp circular geometry, smooth glossy surfaces, clean reflections and gradients, no pixelation, ringing, halos, cloudy plastic, warped edges, or invented texture.
- Keep all typography clean, solid, smooth-edged, and legible without changing its content, color, size, weight, alignment, or position.
- Overall finish: pristine premium cosmetics campaign, smooth high-key studio photography, controlled fine detail, clean color separation, no visible generative noise.

Absolute preservation:
- Preserve the exact composition, crop, portrait identity and appearance, pose, gaze, hairstyle, earrings, hand, held product, clothing geometry, lighting, peach palette, right-side product arrangement, diagonal swatches, and physical product branding.
- Preserve all existing text exactly as shown and exactly once: ‘보정한 듯한’, ‘매끈한 피부 연출’, ‘실리콘 ZERO로 완성하는’, ‘막힘 없는 베이스’.
- Preserve the staggered upper-right text layout. Keep ‘피부 연출’ pale light blue and all other upper-right words warm white.
- Preserve the bottom two-line headline, including pink-beige ‘ZERO’.
- Do not add, remove, rewrite, duplicate, move, resize, or recolor any element.

Avoid: new text, pseudo-text, extra logo, altered product logo, watermark, additional person or product, changed anatomy, changed design, illustration, obvious CGI, excessive smoothing, texture repetition, mottling, noise, banding, blur, or sharpening halos.
experiments.change: 프롬프트 9의 구도·문구·제품 배치를 모두 고정하고 전체 화질만 정리. 아이보리–피치 배경의 얼룩과 밴딩, 인물·의상·머리카락의 반복 미세 패턴, 제품 윤곽과 투명 재질의 흐림·노이즈를 제거하는 고해상도 클린업 패스를 적용.
experiments.worked: 상단 배경 그라데이션이 더 균일하고 매끈하게 이어지며 제품 원형 테두리와 제형 스트로크가 깨끗하게 정리됨. 인물과 머리카락 경계의 거친 노이즈가 줄고 모든 기존 문구, 색상 강조, 위치와 전체 구도가 유지됨.
experiments.failed: 사용자 최종 평가가 필요함. 자연스러운 피부와 의상 질감을 유지해야 하므로 일부 매우 미세한 표면 결은 남아 있으며, 이를 더 제거하면 플라스틱처럼 보일 위험이 있음.
experiments.next: 사용자 평가 후 확정하거나, 필요하면 배경 또는 의상 중 한 영역만 지정해 국소적인 추가 클린업을 진행.

experiments.title: 프롬프트 5 기록
experiments.promptTitle: 더샘 여름 밀착 커버 프로모션 — 기반

- Add broad, soft, abstract curved gradients and diffused glass-like light bands rather than a simple linear gradient. The forms must remain subtle and low contrast, with no recognizable leaves, flowers, waves, clouds, landscape or room.

Reflected color correction:
- Change the pink rim light and pink reflections on the transparent acrylic ring, chrome orbit lines, product case edges and floor to pale mint-green and neutral-white reflections.

Absolute preservation:
Keep the exact five THE SAEM triple-pot products, their positions, sizes, internal three-way divider structures, cream colors, black circular cases, transparent lids, shadows and perspective. Do not add text, objects, plants, leaves, flowers, fruit, clouds, water splash, bubbles, people, hands, model, machine, platform, pseudo-text or watermark. Avoid saturated green, neon green, yellow-green cast over products, dark background, flat single-color fill, illustration, cartoon or obvious CGI.
experiments.change: 프롬프트 4의 제품·타이포·아크릴 링·궤도 구성을 고정하고 배경과 주변 반사광만 아쿠아–블러시에서 연한 민트·셀라돈·밀키 화이트의 추상 곡선 그라데이션으로 변경. 핑크 반사광을 제거함.
experiments.worked: 흰색 여백과 저채도 민트 곡선이 부드러운 유리광처럼 이어져 산뜻하고 시원한 여름 분위기가 형성됨. 코발트 블루와 네이비 문구의 가독성이 유지되고, 제품의 고유한 피치·베이지·올리브·라벤더 제형색과 기존 배치가 보존됨.
experiments.failed: 사용자 최종 평가가 필요함. 이전 아쿠아–블러시 버전보다 색 대비와 에너지가 절제되어, 더 강한 프로모션 인상이 필요하면 민트 채도 또는 그라데이션 방향 중 한 요소만 추가 조정할 수 있음.
experiments.next: 사용자 평가 후 확정하거나, 다음 실험에서 민트 채도 또는 추상 그라데이션의 방향 중 하나만 단일 변수로 조정.

experiments.title: 프롬프트 11 기록

experiments.actualPrompt:

Primary request: Rebuild and clean the photographic details in Image 1 using Images 2 and 3 as high-resolution source references. Restore natural facial detail, smooth tonal transitions, fine hair strands, clean product geometry, translucent materials, reflections and a smooth low-frequency studio gradient. Remove blotches, etched marks, repeating micro-patterns, waxiness, dirty color patches, banding, grain clusters, marbling, compression blocks, cloudy surfaces, blur and generative noise.

Single typography change: enlarge the existing upper-right two-line text block by approximately 15–20%, keeping the same staggered arrangement. First line exactly ‘보정한 듯한’. Second line exactly ‘매끈한 피부 연출’. Keep the first line slightly left and above the second. Keep ‘보정한 듯한’ and ‘매끈한’ warm white; keep only ‘피부 연출’ pale light blue. experiments.change: 프롬프트 10에 고해상도 인물 원본과 제품 원본을 다시 참조해 얼굴·피부·머리카락·손·의상 및 우측 제품·제형의 사진 품질을 복원. 상단 계단형 문구는 약 15–20% 확대하고 기존 색상 구분과 여백을 유지.
experiments.worked: 인물 레퍼런스의 자연스러운 얼굴 비율과 피부 톤, 머리카락 결이 더 선명하게 반영되고 이전의 인공적인 미세 질감이 완화됨. 제품 레퍼런스 기반으로 우측 원형 제품과 투명 테두리, 제형 스트로크가 깨끗하게 정리됨. 상단 문구가 눈에 띄게 커졌지만 인물과 제품에 닿지 않고, 모든 카피와 색상 강조가 유지됨.
experiments.failed: 사용자 최종 평가가 필요함. 우측 제품의 물리적 로고는 레퍼런스와 유사하지만 대소문자 형태의 완전한 일치 여부는 확대 검수가 필요함.
experiments.next: 사용자 평가 후 확정하거나, 다음 실험에서 제품 표면 로고의 정확도만 단일 변수로 보정.

experiments.title: 프롬프트 6 기록

Preserve the large translucent acrylic ring, two thin chrome orbit lines, chrome star points, discount badge and every text element in exactly the same position, size, spelling, color and hierarchy.
Preserve each copy exactly once: “THE SAEM”, “메이크업 아티스트 치트키”, “올영세일”, “더샘 트리플 팟 컨실러”, “7일 특가”, “SALE 15%”, “8.30–9.5”, “1위 컨실러 7일 특가 →”. Preserve square 1:1 crop.

Do not add any text, objects, plants, leaves, flowers, fruit, clouds, water, bubbles, people, hands, model, machine, platform, pseudo-text or watermark. experiments.change: 프롬프트 5의 제품·타이포·구도는 고정하고 배경 팔레트만 정확한 기준색 #82DC28과 #FF7878을 밀키 화이트에 희석한 연한 추상 그라데이션으로 변경. 대응하는 주변 반사광만 함께 조정함.
experiments.worked: 중앙의 넓은 화이트 여백을 유지하면서 좌상·우하에는 연한 코랄핑크, 우상·좌하에는 연한 애플그린이 부드러운 곡선 형태로 번짐. 두 색 사이에 흰색 완충 영역이 있어 탁한 혼색 없이 산뜻하며, 파란 헤드라인과 네이비 문구의 가독성 및 제품 고유색이 유지됨.

experiments.change: 프롬프트 11의 레퍼런스 기반 화질과 전체 구도를 고정하고 상단 둘째 줄의 크기 위계만 변경. ‘매끈한’을 약 18% 축소하고 연한 파랑 ‘피부 연출’을 약 18% 확대.

experiments.next: 사용자 평가 후 확정하거나, 필요하면 손에 든 제품 라벨 정확도만 단일 변수로 보정.

experiments.title: 프롬프트 8 기록
experiments.promptTitle: 더샘 스킨 프렙 여름 프로모션 — 기반
experiments.actualPrompt: Use case: compositing. Asset type: finished vertical 4:5 Korean beauty summer promotion, prompt 8 record. Image 1 is the edit target and authority for canvas, layout, typography, logos, copy, background, footer and price. Image 2 is the exact photographic asset for the LEFT side and authority for the woman's identity, face, pose, skin, hair, clothing, hands, rings and held bottle. Image 3 is the exact product asset for the RIGHT side and authority for the hero bottle silhouette, proportions, cap/pump, pale-blue material, curved white lotion drape, physical printing and sharpness. Place references in order: Image 2 on the left and Image 3 on the right. Fit Image 2 into the existing left model area without changing headline or footer. Replace the right hero product with one upright bottle from Image 3, centered in the pale-blue field, excluding the two lying bottles, original floor and background. Preserve clean high-resolution photographic quality, seamless edges and natural lighting. Prohibit mottling, blotchy color, artificial micro-patterns, repeated texture, maze-like marks, dirty noise, pseudo-text, halos, ghosting, jagged edges, banding and compression smears. Preserve all exact advertising copy, logos, bright light blue-gray ‘9천원대’, split background, footer and 4:5 crop. No additional copy, logo, badge, product, person or watermark.
experiments.change: 프롬프트 7의 광고 레이아웃은 유지하고 사용자가 제공한 레퍼런스를 순서대로 합성. 첫 번째 인물 원본을 좌측에, 두 번째 제품 원본의 세워진 단일 용기와 흰 제형 드레이프를 우측에 배치함.
experiments.worked: 좌측 인물이 첫 번째 원본의 얼굴·자세·손·손에 든 제품을 유지하며 선명하게 배치됨. 우측에는 두 번째 원본의 펌프 구조와 곡선형 흰 제형이 포함된 단일 제품만 들어가고 눕힌 추가 제품은 제외됨. 좌우 비주얼이 로고·헤드라인·푸터와 겹치지 않으며 기존 광고 문구와 밝은 블루그레이 가격이 유지됨.
experiments.next: 최종 성공 프롬프트로 확정되어 라이브러리 자산으로 승격함.

experiments.title: 프롬프트 1 기록
experiments.promptTitle: 더샘 팁 컨실러 브라이트너 — 옵티컬 에디토리얼 기반
experiments.actualPrompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: finished square 1:1 Korean beauty retail campaign, new independent campaign, prompt 1 record

Input images and authority:
- Image 1 is the absolute identity and photography reference for the single female model: preserve her recognizable face, facial proportions, eyes, nose, lips, skin tone, natural skin texture, black hair tied with a white scrunchie, wispy strands, pearl earring, white off-shoulder top, hand anatomy, manicure and bright high-key beauty lighting. Her pose may be adapted to the new composition, but do not turn her into a different person.
- Image 2 is the absolute product reference for THE SAEM Cover Perfection Tip Concealer: preserve the slim transparent rectangular tubes, glossy black cylindrical caps, beige shade range, proportions, materials and vertical physical “The saem” printing. Use exactly three product units selected from the reference, not five.
- Image 3 is the exact THE SAEM logo artwork. Reproduce this logo once as the top brand mark, without altering its spelling, letterform or proportions.

Creative direction — different from the previous white ecommerce banner:
Create an original “brightening spotlight” editorial campaign. Do not use the previous composition of model on the right, stacked black headline on the left, giant pink bubble price, bottom full-width pink sale bar, or product/applicator packshot cluster. Instead use a spacious diagonal composition with translucent acrylic, optical light and a refined magazine hierarchy.

Canvas and background:
Square 1:1. A luminous pearl-white to very pale blush gradient with soft cool-lilac shadows. Add one large translucent circular acrylic disc slightly right of center, with subtle prismatic peach-pink edge reflections. Add two thin silver orbit lines and one broad diagonal beam of soft white light traveling from upper-right toward the model's cheek. No room, landscape, flowers or solid pink footer.

Model composition:
Place the same model from Image 1 as a cropped beauty portrait occupying the left 42–46% of the canvas. Show her head, neck, one shoulder and one hand. Use a three-quarter view with her gaze toward camera and a subtle confident smile. She holds one closed concealer lightly near the lower cheekbone, angled upward approximately 20 degrees, visually following the brightening beam. Preserve her exact identity and natural premium skin detail; use restrained coral makeup and crisp hair strands. Keep the face free of typography.

Product composition:
On the right, arrange exactly three concealer tubes from Image 2 as a sculptural floating trio across the translucent acrylic disc: one large upright hero tube at center-right, one smaller tube leaning 18 degrees behind it, and one horizontal tube near the lower-right edge. Preserve realistic perspective, transparent beige liquid, glossy black caps and the authentic vertical physical “The saem” print. Add soft contact/reflection shadows on the acrylic disc and restrained pearl highlights. Do not include an opened tube, wand or cosmetic smear.

Typography and information layout:
- Place the exact Image 3 logo “THE SAEM” small at upper-left, aligned to the portrait edge.
- Near upper-center, add a small black modern Korean sans-serif eyebrow: “더샘 팁 컨실러 브라이트너”.
- Set the main headline in the upper-right quadrant, clear of the products, in editorial cobalt-blue Korean sans-serif with generous line spacing:
“빛을 설계하는”
“청담샵 브라이트너”
Make the second line larger and bolder.
- Behind the products, add one oversized translucent italic serif watermark in pale blush, low opacity: “BRIGHTENING SPOT”. It must remain secondary and not cross the model's face.
- Add a compact white index card with thin cobalt border near the lower center-right. Inside place “SALE 14%” in cobalt blue, with 14% dominant.
- Directly below or beside the card, set “6천원대” once in bold hot-coral sans-serif, medium-large but not bubble lettering and not outlined.
- Along the bottom-left, above the safe margin, use a thin cobalt underline and small dark-navy copy: “누적 판매량 6,000만 국민 컨실러 →”.

Exact advertising copy, each exactly once and no other added advertising copy:
“THE SAEM”
“더샘 팁 컨실러 브라이트너”
“빛을 설계하는”
“청담샵 브라이트너”
“BRIGHTENING SPOT”
“SALE 14%”
“6천원대”
“누적 판매량 6,000만 국민 컨실러 →”
Physical “The saem” printing may remain on the three real product tubes as packaging detail.

Style and palette:
Contemporary Korean beauty editorial with optical-light art direction, premium high-key photography, pearl white, pale blush, cool lilac, cobalt blue, hot coral accents, translucent acrylic and chrome lines. Sophisticated, airy and shoppable, not childish and not a dense sale flyer.

Hard constraints:
Exactly one woman and exactly three product tubes on the acrylic disc, plus the one closed tube held by the model; no opened product, wand, swatch or extra container. Preserve product geometry and model identity. Do not add the Olive Young logo, event logo, dates, pink footer bar, round pink discount badge, giant outlined 3D price, extra copy, pseudo-text, additional logos or watermark. No malformed hands, duplicate fingers, altered face, plastic skin, warped tubes, missing caps, unreadable physical branding, cropped headline, text over the face, plants, fruit, flowers, liquid splash, illustration, cartoon or cheap CGI.
experiments.change: 기존 흰색 쇼핑 배너의 좌측 카피·우측 모델·대형 핑크 가격·하단 핑크 띠를 사용하지 않고, 동일 모델과 팁 컨실러를 펄 화이트·라일락 광학 조명, 투명 아크릴 디스크와 제품 오비탈 중심의 비대칭 에디토리얼로 새로 구성.
experiments.worked: 레퍼런스 모델의 얼굴·헤어·스크런치·진주 귀걸이·손과 제품이 자연스럽게 유지됨. 오른쪽 아크릴 디스크 위에 세 개의 팁 컨실러가 세로·사선·가로로 명확히 분리되고, 프리즘 광선과 코발트 블루 헤드라인이 기존 전단과 다른 프리미엄 방향을 형성함. 가격과 할인 정보도 작은 카드형 위계로 정돈됨.
experiments.failed: 사용자 최종 평가가 필요함. 제품 3개와 모델이 든 제품까지 총 4개가 표시되어 제품군의 존재감이 강하며, 배경 워터마크가 일부 제품 뒤에서 낮은 대비로 보임.
experiments.next: 사용자 평가 후 다음 실험에서는 제품 수 또는 워터마크 대비 중 한 요소만 조정.

experiments.title: 프롬프트 2 기록
experiments.promptTitle: 더샘 팁 컨실러 브라이트너 — 옵티컬 에디토리얼 기반
experiments.actualPrompt:
Use case: compositing
Asset type: finished square 1:1 Korean beauty retail campaign, prompt 2 record

Input images and authority:
- Image 1 is the edit target and absolute authority for the model identity, THE SAEM logo, all existing copy, pearl-blush-lilac optical background, acrylic disc, orbit lines, product geometry, lighting, typography and square crop.
- Image 2 is the exact official horizontal Olive Young Sale emblem to insert. Preserve its complete Korean lettering “올영세일”, date “8.30–9.5”, cobalt and light-blue fills, white interior shapes, black outline, white outer border, proportions and horizontal silhouette. Do not redraw, translate, restyle, crop or change the emblem.

Required edit 1 — add emblem:
Place the complete Image 2 Olive Young Sale emblem in the upper-right corner of Image 1, fully inside the canvas with 28–40 px safe margins from the top and right edges. Size it approximately 17–20% of the canvas width. Keep it horizontal and undistorted. It must sit in open pale background space and must not overlap THE SAEM logo, the model's hair or face, “더샘 팁 컨실러 브라이트너”, “빛을 설계하는”, or “청담샵 브라이트너”. If required, shift the existing upper-center eyebrow and blue headline slightly left or down by the minimum amount needed, preserving their hierarchy and wording.

Required edit 2 — prevent right product cropping:
The horizontal concealer tube at the lower-right is currently cropped by the right canvas edge. Recompose ONLY the right-side product sculpture and acrylic disc so every one of the three display products is fully visible, including the complete glossy black cap, transparent tube body, bottom edge and physical “The saem” print. Scale the three-product display group and the acrylic disc down approximately 10–14% and move them left approximately 6–9% of the canvas width. Keep the upright, leaning and horizontal arrangement, realistic relative scale, reflections, contact shadows and optical orbit composition. Maintain at least 36 px clear space between every product extremity and the right canvas edge. Do not crop any product at the bottom edge. Keep the model and the one product held at her cheek unchanged.

Absolute preservation:
Preserve exactly one woman, her identity, face, hair, white scrunchie, pearl earring, hand, manicure, white top and held concealer. Preserve the three right-side concealers with accurate transparent beige bodies, glossy black caps and packaging print. Preserve “THE SAEM”, “더샘 팁 컨실러 브라이트너”, “빛을 설계하는”, “청담샵 브라이트너”, “BRIGHTENING SPOT”, “SALE 14%”, “6천원대”, and “누적 판매량 6,000만 국민 컨실러 →” exactly once. Add the emblem texts “올영세일” and “8.30–9.5” only as part of the supplied official emblem. Keep all text off the model's face.

Do not add or remove products, rewrite copy, alter discounts, invent dates, distort the official emblem, change the model, crop products, add a footer bar, add a round badge, create extra logos, pseudo-text or watermark. Avoid malformed hands, plastic skin, warped tubes, detached caps, product overlap with the emblem, clipped typography, illustration, cartoon or cheap CGI.
experiments.change: 프롬프트 1의 우측 상단에 사용자가 제공한 공식 가로형 올영세일 엠블럼을 추가. 우측 제품 3개와 아크릴 디스크를 약간 축소해 왼쪽으로 이동하여 가로 제품의 검은 캡까지 프레임 안에 완전히 수납.
experiments.worked: 올영세일 엠블럼의 가로 비율, 코발트·라이트블루 색상, 흰색과 검은색 외곽선 및 날짜가 우측 상단에서 선명하게 유지됨. 세 개의 우측 제품이 모두 완전한 실루엣으로 보이며 특히 가로 제품의 검은 캡이 잘리지 않음. 모델, 제품 형상, 기존 카피와 옵티컬 에디토리얼 분위기가 유지됨.
experiments.failed: 사용자 최종 평가가 필요함. 우측 상단 엠블럼 추가로 상단 정보 밀도가 높아졌으며, 헤드라인은 원래보다 중앙 쪽으로 압축된 인상을 줄 수 있음.
experiments.next: 사용자 평가 후 확정하거나, 필요하면 엠블럼 크기 또는 헤드라인 위치 중 하나만 미세 조정.

experiments.title: 프롬프트 3 기록
experiments.promptTitle: 더샘 팁 컨실러 브라이트너 — 옵티컬 에디토리얼 기반
experiments.actualPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: finished square 1:1 Korean beauty retail campaign, prompt 3 record
Input image: Image 1 is the sole edit target and absolute authority for the model, products, Olive Young emblem, THE SAEM logo, headline, background, acrylic disc, orbit lines, product geometry, lighting and square crop.

Primary edit — create one integrated footer promotion panel:
Remove the three currently separate lower promotional text treatments from their existing positions: the underlined bottom-left line “누적 판매량 6,000만 국민 컨실러 →”, the white outlined “SALE 14%” card near lower center, and the coral “6천원대” below it. Rebuild these three messages inside one new full-width pink footer box at the very bottom.

Footer box design:
- Add a solid sophisticated warm pink footer panel spanning the complete canvas width, approximately 14–16% of the image height.
- Use color around #F28BAF to #F58EAE, with a very subtle vertical tonal gradient. Keep it clean and opaque enough for text legibility, not translucent.
- Round only the top-left and top-right corners generously, approximately 34–42 px. Keep the bottom corners aligned flush with the canvas.
- Add a restrained soft shadow along the top edge to separate the panel from the portrait and acrylic scene.
- Do not cover the model's face, held product, the right product trio, or the lower edge of the acrylic disc more than necessary. The panel may overlap only the very bottom of the model's white clothing and empty floor/reflection area.

Information layout inside the pink panel, reading left to right:
1. Left zone, approximately 42% width: place the exact white bold Korean copy on two balanced lines if needed:
“누적 판매량 6,000만”
“국민 컨실러”
Use a clean bold Korean sans-serif. Keep comfortable left padding and no underline. Do not include the old arrow.
2. Center zone, approximately 20% width: add a compact white rounded badge with a thin cobalt-blue border. Inside it place cobalt-blue “SALE” above or beside a dominant “14%”. Keep the exact combined message “SALE 14%” once and fully inside the badge.
3. Right zone, approximately 30% width: place the exact price “6천원대” once in large bold white Korean sans-serif. Use a very subtle cobalt-blue drop shadow or thin cool-blue lower-right extrusion for separation, but no bubble lettering and no thick outline.
- Vertically center all three information groups within the pink panel and align their visual baselines. Use clear spacing and thin optional white divider lines between zones only if helpful.
- Keep every glyph fully inside the panel with at least 28 px internal padding from all edges.

Text correction:
Use the correct Korean word “누적”, not “누석”. The full semantic copy must read exactly “누적 판매량 6,000만 국민 컨실러”. Show it only once across its line break.

Absolute preservation:
Preserve “THE SAEM”, “더샘 팁 컨실러 브라이트너”, “빛을 설계하는”, “청담샵 브라이트너”, “BRIGHTENING SPOT”, the official “올영세일 8.30–9.5” emblem, all four visible concealer products, the model's identity and anatomy, and all non-footer elements exactly. Keep the three right-side products fully inside the frame, including the horizontal tube's black cap.

Do not add any other copy, price, discount, badge, logo, date, product, icon, arrow, pseudo-text or watermark. Do not alter the model, product count, packaging, official emblem, upper typography or optical background. Avoid footer text overflow, cropped letters, duplicate promotional copy, malformed Korean, overly saturated neon pink, red footer, plastic skin, warped products, illustration or cheap CGI.
experiments.change: 프롬프트 2의 하단에 전체 폭의 웜핑크 라운드 패널을 추가하고, 기존에 흩어져 있던 누적 판매 문구·SALE 14%·6천원대를 패널 안의 좌·중·우 3단 정보 구조로 재배치. 사용자 입력의 ‘누석’은 올바른 ‘누적’으로 교정함.
experiments.worked: 하단 프로모션 정보가 하나의 핑크 패널로 통합되어 읽는 순서가 명확해짐. 왼쪽 누적 판매 문구, 중앙 할인 배지, 오른쪽 가격이 균형 있게 배치되고 글자가 모두 패널 안에 수납됨. 모델 얼굴, 올영세일 엠블럼, 제품 4개와 상단 카피가 유지됨.
experiments.failed: 사용자 최종 평가가 필요함. 핑크 패널이 추가되면서 이전 버전의 가볍고 넓은 하단 여백보다 리테일 프로모션 성격이 강해짐.
experiments.next: 사용자 평가 후 확정하거나, 필요하면 핑크 패널 높이 또는 가격 글자 크기 중 하나만 조정.

experiments.title: 프롬프트 4 기록
experiments.promptTitle: 더샘 팁 컨실러 브라이트너 — 옵티컬 에디토리얼 기반
experiments.actualPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: finished square 1:1 Korean beauty retail campaign, prompt 4 record
Input image: Image 1 is the sole edit target and absolute authority for model, products, official emblems, headline, footer, background, acrylic disc, lighting and crop.

Primary edit 1 — replace right watermark:
Completely remove the oversized pale italic serif text ‘BRIGHTENING SPOT’ from the right side. Reconstruct the exposed pearl-white, pale blush and cool-lilac optical background, diagonal light beam, acrylic disc and orbit lines seamlessly with no ghost letters.
In the cleared upper-right/mid-right area, below the official Olive Young Sale emblem and above the three product tubes, place one light-pink circular discount badge. Use a soft pale blush pink fill around #F6B6C9, clean edge, subtle translucent-glass highlight and restrained soft shadow. Keep the circle fully inside the canvas and do not overlap the blue headline, official emblem or products.
Inside the circle place exactly:
‘SALE’
‘14%’
Use cobalt-blue modern sans-serif; SALE smaller, 14% large and bold. Center both lines and keep all glyphs fully inside with generous padding.

Remove the existing white rounded rectangular ‘SALE 14%’ badge from the center of the bottom pink footer. Fill its old area seamlessly with the same pink gradient and paper texture. Do not leave duplicate text.
Rebalance the footer into two zones only: keep ‘누적 판매량 6,000만 국민 컨실러’ on the left and ‘6천원대’ on the right. Slightly widen their spacing/position if needed so the footer feels intentional, but keep each exact phrase once, fully contained and legible. Preserve the footer height, warm pink color, rounded upper corners and shadow.

Absolute preservation:
Preserve exactly the model identity/face/hair/scrunchie/pearl earring/hand/held product; THE SAEM logo; official ‘올영세일 8.30–9.5’ emblem; ‘더샘 팁 컨실러 브라이트너’, ‘빛을 설계하는’, ‘청담샵 브라이트너’; all four concealer products and packaging; acrylic disc; orbit lines; optical background; square crop.
Keep the three right-side products fully inside the frame including the horizontal black cap.
The text ‘BRIGHTENING SPOT’ must not appear anywhere.
‘SALE 14%’ must appear exactly once, only inside the new circular badge.
Keep ‘누적 판매량 6,000만 국민 컨실러’ and ‘6천원대’ exactly once.

Do not add text, logo, badge, date, product, icon, pseudo-text or watermark. Avoid ghosted watermark letters, duplicated discount, text overflow, product cropping, malformed Korean, warped products, altered face/hand, illustration or CGI.
experiments.change: 프롬프트 3 우측의 BRIGHTENING SPOT 워터마크를 제거하고 같은 영역에 연한 핑크 원형 SALE 14% 배지를 배치. 하단의 중복 할인 배지는 제거하고 누적 판매 문구와 6천원대만 2단 구조로 재정렬함.
experiments.worked: BRIGHTENING SPOT 문구가 흔적 없이 제거되고 연한 핑크 원형 할인 배지가 우측 제품 위에 선명하게 배치됨. SALE 14%는 한 번만 표시되며, 하단 패널은 누적 판매 문구와 6천원대만 남아 단순해짐. 우측 가로 제품의 검은 캡까지 프레임 안에 유지됨.
experiments.failed: 사용자 최종 평가가 필요함.
experiments.next: 사용자 평가 후 확정하거나, 필요하면 원형 배지의 크기 또는 위치 중 하나만 미세 조정.

experiments.title: 프롬프트 5 기록

Left price treatment:
Place ‘6천원대’ once in the left 34–38% of the footer, vertically centered. Make it the dominant price lockup and adapt it to the pink background in the spirit of Image 2: bold contemporary Korean display lettering, bright white main face, restrained cobalt-blue offset shadow or lower-right extrusion, and a very thin pale highlight edge. Keep it refined and highly legible, not cartoonish, not inflated bubble lettering. Keep generous padding from the left edge, panel top and panel bottom; no character may be clipped.

Right sales-copy treatment:
Place exactly ‘누적 판매량 6,000만 국민 컨실러’ once in the remaining right side, as one clean horizontal line if it fits safely; otherwise use two balanced lines without changing characters. Use bold white Korean sans-serif, smaller than the price, centered vertically and optically balanced. No arrow. Leave a clear gap between the price and the sales copy. Remove the old vertical divider unless a shorter subtle white divider improves separation.

Removal and reconstruction:
Fully erase both old footer text instances before repositioning them. Rebuild exposed areas with the identical warm-pink gradient, texture and lighting; no ghost letters or flat patches.

Absolute preservation:
Preserve every non-footer element of Image 1 exactly: model identity, face, hair, white scrunchie, pearl earring, hand, held tube, THE SAEM logo, official Olive Young Sale emblem and its date, all upper Korean copy, the single pale-pink circular SALE 14% badge, all three products on the right, acrylic disc, orbit lines, optical background, lighting and square crop. Keep all right-side products fully visible including the horizontal black cap.

Exact text rules:
‘6천원대’ exactly once, only on the left of the footer.
‘누적 판매량 6,000만 국민 컨실러’ exactly once, only on the right of the footer.
‘SALE 14%’ remains exactly once in the upper-right circular badge.
Do not add an arrow, date, badge, emblem, copy, pseudo-text, logo or watermark. Do not alter Korean spelling, product geometry, face, hand, or crop.
experiments.change: 프롬프트 4의 하단 두 문구 위치를 교환하고, 왼쪽 ‘6천원대’를 레퍼런스의 고대비 표현을 참고한 흰색 글자와 절제된 코발트 그림자로 재스타일링함.
experiments.worked: ‘6천원대’가 하단 왼쪽의 주목도 높은 가격 정보로 배치되고, 누적 판매 문구는 오른쪽 한 줄로 정리됨. 핑크 배경과 흰색·코발트 타이포의 대비가 자연스럽고 모든 글자가 패널 안에 수납됨. 상단 원형 SALE 14% 배지와 인물·제품·로고가 유지됨.
experiments.failed: 사용자 최종 평가가 필요함.
experiments.next: 사용자 평가 후 확정하거나, 필요하면 왼쪽 가격 크기 또는 오른쪽 문구 굵기 중 하나만 미세 조정.

experiments.title: 프롬프트 6 기록
experiments.promptTitle: 더샘 팁 컨실러 브라이트너 — 옵티컬 에디토리얼 기반

The result must look like a clean premium source photograph integrated into the ad, not an AI-painted or repeatedly regenerated face.

Retain gentle natural blush and highlights. Do not beautify into a different face or erase all real skin texture.

Keep all text exactly once and do not alter any glyph. Keep the three right-side products fully inside the frame, including the complete horizontal black cap.

No new text, logo, badge, product, person, pattern, watermark, pseudo-text, background object or decorative texture. No identity drift, face reshaping, pose change, hand mutation, product warping, plastic skin, painterly rendering, CGI, fabric pattern, repeated texture, moiré, banding, blotches or grain.
experiments.change: 프롬프트 5의 레이아웃과 문구를 고정하고, 사용자가 제공한 고해상도 인물 원본을 기준으로 얼굴·피부·머리카락·손·들고 있는 제품 영역의 얼룩과 반복형 생성 패턴을 복원함.
